name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 8 times in 3 visits over 20 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 16 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 20 hours starting 2026-06-04, at wavelengths from 2.00 to 4.95 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
